entries.title: Thorned Fortress
entries.body:
# Thorned Fortress

## Overview
Your mastery over living plant magic allows you to reinforce your summoned guardians with dense bark, razor-sharp thorns, and resilient vines.

Whether it is an Entling, a Spirit Bloom summon, or another plant-based creature under your control, your summons become living fortresses that punish those foolish enough to engage them in close combat.

The thorns that cover their bodies are more than simple defences. They instinctively react to danger, tearing into enemies that strike them or become ensnared within their grasp.

Many Druids believe this blessing was first taught by the Elder Ents themselves, who learned long ago that the strongest defence is one that discourages an enemy from attacking in the first place.

---

## Rank 1
### Description

Your mastery over living plant magic allows you to reinforce your summoned guardians with dense bark, razor-sharp thorns, and resilient vines.

Whether it is an Entling, a Spirit Bloom summon, or another plant-based creature under your control, your summons become living fortresses that punish those foolish enough to engage them in close combat.

The thorns that cover their bodies are more than simple defences. They instinctively react to danger, tearing into enemies that strike them or become ensnared within their grasp.

Many Druids believe this blessing was first taught by the Elder Ents themselves, who learned long ago that the strongest defence is one that discourages an enemy from attacking in the first place.

---

### Effects

- This is a **Passive Talent**.
- All **Plant-based Summons** you control gain the **Thorned** trait.
- Plant-based summons gain:
  - **+10 Maximum HP**
  - **+1 Attack Damage**
- Whenever a creature hits one of your Plant-based summons with a **melee attack**, it immediately suffers **2 Piercing Damage** from the creature's thorns.
- If one of your Plant-based summons successfully **Grapples** a creature, the grappled creature suffers **2 Piercing Damage** at the **start of each of its turns** while the grapple is maintained.
- Thorn damage ignores non-magical armour but may still be reduced by abilities or resistances that reduce **Piercing Damage**.

---

### Lore

The oldest forests in Asteria are home to trees whose bark is harder than stone and whose thorns have grown for centuries. These ancient guardians survive not through aggression, but by making every attack against them costly.

Druids who master Thorned Fortress learn to weave that same natural resilience into their summoned companions. Bark thickens, vines tighten, and thorns emerge wherever an enemy dares to strike.

Among the Verdant Circles, this gift is viewed as a symbol of nature's quiet strength. A forest does not chase its enemies—it simply ensures they regret every step they take within it.

---

> *"Strike a thorn once, and you curse the thorn. Strike a living forest, and you soon realise the thorn was showing mercy."*  
> — **Elder Brambleheart, Keeper of the Ironwood Grove**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your mastery over living plant guardians continues to grow, allowing thicker bark and stronger thorned vines to form around your summoned allies.

The once modest defensive thorns now develop into dense natural armour, making your summons significantly more resilient in battle. Their grasp tightens, and every attempt to break free from their embrace comes at a painful cost.

Experienced Druids often shape their summoned guardians into the front line of battle, allowing them to absorb attacks while the forest slowly wears down those who refuse to retreat.

To many within the Druidic Circles, Thorned Fortress is proof that nature's greatest strength is not its ability to attack—but its ability to endure.

---

### Effects

- This is a **Passive Talent**.
- All **Plant-based Summons** you control gain the **Thorned** trait.
- Plant-based summons gain:
  - **+20 Maximum HP**
  - **+2 Attack Damage**
  - **+2 to Grapple Checks**
- Whenever a creature hits one of your Plant-based summons with a **melee attack**, it immediately suffers **3 Piercing Damage** from the creature's thorns.
- If one of your Plant-based summons successfully **Grapples** a creature, the grappled creature suffers **3 Piercing Damage** at the **start of each of its turns** while the grapple is maintained.
- Thorn damage ignores non-magical armour but may still be reduced by abilities or resistances that reduce **Piercing Damage**.

---

### Lore

As a Druid's bond with the forest deepens, their summoned guardians begin to resemble the ancient defenders that watch over the oldest groves of Asteria.

Layers of bark harden like living armour while thorn-covered vines instinctively wrap around any creature that ventures too close. Every wound inflicted upon these guardians is answered by the forest itself.

The oldest Ents are said to have developed these natural defences over thousands of years, their bark becoming almost impenetrable while their thorns served as a warning to those who sought to destroy the wild.

Druids who master Thorned Fortress do not simply summon allies—they summon pieces of the forest's enduring will.

---

> *"The forest does not fear those who strike first. It simply outlasts them until they strike no more."*  
> — **Grovekeeper Maelis Briarroot, Warden of the Thornwood**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your summoned guardians now embody the relentless resilience of the oldest forests. Their bark grows thicker than ironwood, while long, barbed vines coil around their limbs, waiting to punish anything that comes within reach.

Enemies quickly learn that every strike against these guardians carries a price. The deeper they become entangled, the more the living thorns tear into flesh and armour alike.

At this stage, your plant summons are no longer simple defenders. They become wardens of the battlefield, capable of locking enemies in place while the forest slowly overwhelms them.

Many Druids consider this the point where their summons truly become extensions of the Living Forest itself.

---

### Effects

- This is a **Passive Talent**.
- All **Plant-based Summons** you control gain the **Thorned** trait.
- Plant-based summons gain:
  - **+30 Maximum HP**
  - **+4 Attack Damage**
  - **+6 to Grapple Checks**
- Whenever a creature hits one of your Plant-based summons with a **melee attack**, it immediately suffers **4 Piercing Damage**.
- If one of your Plant-based summons successfully **Grapples** a creature, the grappled creature suffers **4 Piercing Damage** at the start of each of its turns.
- Grappled creatures must succeed on a **Constitution Check (DC 15)** at the start of their turn or suffer **1d4 Bleeding Damage**.
- Thorn damage ignores non-magical armour but may still be reduced by abilities or resistances that reduce **Piercing Damage**.

---

### Lore

Ancient records tell of forests where even the bravest warriors refused to tread. Not because the trees moved, but because every branch, vine, and thorn seemed determined to drive intruders away.

Druids who master Thorned Fortress begin to recreate these legendary guardians through their summons. Every layer of bark becomes stronger, every thorn sharper, and every vine more determined to hold those who threaten the balance of nature.

To stand against one of these guardians is to wage war against the patience of the forest itself. Every wound inflicted is answered in kind, until even the strongest enemies find themselves exhausted by the unyielding embrace of living wood.

---

> *"The wise fear the beast's bite. The wiser fear the tree that refuses to let go."*  
> — **Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, Warden of the Ironwood Circle**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your command over living plant guardians reaches a level few Druids ever achieve. Thick layers of enchanted bark encase your summons, while ancient thorned vines constantly regenerate across their bodies, making them exceptionally difficult to bring down.

The forest no longer merely protects its guardians—it actively punishes those who challenge them. Every strike against your summons is met with a painful reminder that nature is both patient and relentless. Enemies who become trapped within their grasp quickly find themselves bleeding beneath an endless mass of barbed vines.

Veteran Druids often position their summoned guardians at the heart of the battlefield, allowing them to hold the line while allies fight from the safety of the living fortress they have created.

---

### Effects

- This is a **Passive Talent**.
- All **Plant-based Summons** you control gain the **Thorned** trait.
- Plant-based summons gain:
  - **+40 Maximum HP**
  - **+6 Attack Damage**
  - **+6 to Grapple Checks**
- Whenever a creature hits one of your Plant-based summons with a **melee attack**, it immediately suffers **6 Piercing Damage**.
- If one of your Plant-based summons successfully **Grapples** a creature, the grappled creature suffers **6 Piercing Damage** at the start of each of its turns.
- Grappled creatures must succeed on a **Constitution Check (DC 13)** at the start of their turn or suffer **1d6 Bleeding Damage**.
- Thorn damage ignores non-magical armour but may still be reduced by abilities or resistances that reduce **Piercing Damage**.
- Plant-based summons gain **Resistance to non-magical Slashing Damage** as their bark hardens into living armour.

---

### Lore

Among the oldest groves of Asteria stand trees that have endured countless wars, storms, and disasters. Their bark bears the scars of centuries, yet they continue to grow stronger with each passing season.

Druids who master Thorned Fortress begin to emulate these ancient guardians. Their summoned companions become living bastions whose purpose is not simply to fight, but to endure. Every thorn, every vine, and every layer of bark exists to protect the balance of nature and those who fight beside it.

The greatest forest wardens teach that true strength is measured not by how hard one strikes, but by how long one can stand against the darkness.

---

> *"An axe may wound the bark, but the forest remembers the hand that swung it."*  
> — **High Warden Sylvara Rootheart, Keeper of the Ironwood Grove**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your mastery over the Living Forest reaches its ultimate expression. The guardians that answer your call become legendary protectors, clad in ancient bark and covered in countless enchanted thorns that have grown for centuries.

Every branch, vine, and thorn becomes a weapon of defence. Those who attack your summons quickly discover that every strike is answered by the forest itself. Their bark becomes almost impossible to penetrate, while their grasp tightens with the unyielding strength of ancient roots.

To the Druids of old, this stage represents the perfect balance between strength and patience. The forest does not pursue its enemies, nor does it seek conquest. Instead, it stands firm, allowing those who threaten the natural world to defeat themselves against its living walls.

An Elder Ent protected by Thorned Fortress is said to resemble the oldest trees in Asteria—silent, immovable, and utterly relentless.

---

### Effects

- This is a **Passive Talent**.
- All **Plant-based Summons** you control gain the **Thorned** trait.
- Plant-based summons gain:
  - **+50 Maximum HP**
  - **+8 Attack Damage**
  - **+8 to Grapple Checks**
- Whenever a creature hits one of your Plant-based summons with a **melee attack**, it immediately suffers **8 Piercing Damage**.
- If one of your Plant-based summons successfully **Grapples** a creature, the grappled creature suffers **8 Piercing Damage** at the start of each of its turns.
- Grappled creatures must succeed on a **Constitution Check (DC 10)** at the start of their turn or suffer **2d6 Bleeding Damage**.
- Thorn damage ignores non-magical armour but may still be reduced by abilities or resistances that reduce **Piercing Damage**.
- Plant-based summons gain **Resistance to non-magical Slashing and Piercing Damage**.
- Once per round, when a Plant-based summon is reduced below **50% of its maximum HP**, thorn-covered vines surge across its body, granting it **Temporary HP equal to 10% of its maximum HP**. This effect may trigger **once per summon**.

---

### Lore

The oldest legends speak of forests so ancient that invading armies simply vanished beneath their canopies. Those who survived claimed that the trees themselves fought back, their living guardians refusing to yield even after suffering terrible wounds.

These stories are believed to have inspired the creation of Thorned Fortress. Rather than teaching Druids how to create stronger summons, the talent teaches them how to awaken the ancient resilience that already exists within every guardian spirit of the forest.

To witness an Elder Ent protected by Thorned Fortress is to understand why entire kingdoms once feared entering the sacred groves of Asteria. The guardian does not rage or pursue. It simply endures, standing between the innocent and those who would bring harm, until the forest itself has claimed victory.

---

> *"Strength fells a tree. Patience grows a forest. Endurance protects it for eternity."*  
> — **Grand Archdruid Elarion Wildroot, Guardian of the First Grove**

## Prerequisites
None

entries.title: Aura of Courage
entries.body:
# Aura of Courage

## Overview
A Paladin's courage is more than personal resolve—it is a beacon that strengthens the spirits of those who stand beside them. Through unwavering faith and an unbreakable oath, you project a divine aura that steels the hearts of your allies against fear and despair.

While your aura remains active, those who fight within its protective embrace find their resolve strengthened before terror can take hold. Even allies already gripped by fear may find the courage to rise again as they draw close to your presence, though true protection belongs to those who never abandon the light of your conviction.

Aura of Courage is the first manifestation of a Paladin's divine presence upon the battlefield. It marks the beginning of your journey as a guardian whose faith protects not only their own heart, but the hearts of every companion willing to stand beside them.

## Rank 1
### Description

A Paladin's courage is more than personal resolve—it is a beacon that strengthens the spirits of those who stand beside them. Through unwavering faith and an unbreakable oath, you project a divine aura that steels the hearts of your allies against fear and despair.

While your aura remains active, those who fight within its protective embrace find their resolve strengthened before terror can take hold. Even allies already gripped by fear may find the courage to rise again as they draw close to your presence, though true protection belongs to those who never abandon the light of your conviction.

Aura of Courage is the first manifestation of a Paladin's divine presence upon the battlefield. It marks the beginning of your journey as a guardian whose faith protects not only their own heart, but the hearts of every companion willing to stand beside them.

### Effects

- Spend **15 MP** to activate **Aura of Courage**.
- Create a **5 metre radius Aura** centred on yourself for **3 Rounds**.
- The aura moves with you.
- Allies already within the aura gain **+2 to Saving Throws against the Fear condition**.
- If an ally is targeted by a Fear effect while already inside the aura, the **+2 bonus** is applied to their Saving Throw.
- An ally that enters the aura while already suffering the **Fear** condition may immediately attempt **one new Saving Throw** to end the effect.
- This Saving Throw gains **+1** *(half the aura's normal bonus, rounded down)*.
- This reroll may only be attempted **once per aura activation** for each creature.
- Multiple **Aura of Courage** effects do not stack. If affected by more than one, only the strongest version applies.

### Lore

Within every holy order of Asteria, courage is considered a gift that grows stronger when shared. Veteran Paladins teach that fear cannot be defeated through words alone—it is overcome by standing shoulder to shoulder with those who refuse to yield.

The first lesson every initiate learns is that an aura is not a shield that follows the fearful. It is a sanctuary for those who place their trust in the Paladin's conviction. Those who remain within its light discover that even the darkest horrors lose their power when faced together.

> *"Courage is not the absence of fear. It is the decision to stand firm despite it—and to help others do the same."*  
> **— Lady Seraphine, Shieldbearer of the Eternal Dawn**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your courage grows into an unwavering beacon that shines brighter across the battlefield. Allies fighting beside you find their resolve strengthened, allowing them to face horrors that would break the spirits of lesser warriors. Your faith stands as a constant reminder that fear only has power over those who surrender to it.

As your divine presence matures, your aura reaches farther and lingers longer, encouraging companions to remain close to your side where your conviction is strongest. Those who flee may still find refuge by returning to your light, but the greatest protection belongs to those who never leave it.

Veteran Paladins often describe this stage of mastery as the moment their companions stop looking at the monsters before them and instead draw confidence from the steadfast guardian standing at their side.

### Effects

- Spend **25 MP** to activate **Aura of Courage**.
- Create a **7 metre radius Aura** centred on yourself for **4 Rounds**.
- The aura moves with you.
- Allies already within the aura gain **+3 to Saving Throws against the Fear condition**.
- If an ally is targeted by a Fear effect while already inside the aura, the **+3 bonus** is applied to their Saving Throw.
- An ally that enters the aura while already suffering the **Fear** condition may immediately attempt **one new Saving Throw** to end the effect.
- This Saving Throw gains **+1** *(half the aura's normal bonus, rounded down)*.
- This reroll may only be attempted **once per aura activation** for each creature.
- Multiple **Aura of Courage** effects do not stack. If affected by more than one, only the strongest version applies.

### Lore

The oldest knightly orders teach that courage is not born from victory, but from trust. Warriors who stand beside a seasoned Paladin often find themselves confronting impossible odds with a calm they cannot fully explain. It is not the absence of fear that strengthens them, but the certainty that they do not stand alone.

Many commanders intentionally place experienced Paladins where enemy terror is expected to be greatest. Their presence has turned collapsing battle lines into legendary last stands, proving that a single steadfast soul can become the foundation upon which an entire army refuses to break.

> *"Stand with me, and let your courage become greater than your fear."*  
> **— Dame Elowyn, Captain of the Silver Wardens**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your unwavering faith becomes a beacon that reaches beyond courage alone. Allies who stand within your divine presence find their minds fortified against both terror and manipulation, allowing them to remain steadfast when others would falter.

The aura you project is no longer simply a source of bravery—it becomes a sanctuary of resolve. Those who fight beneath your protection discover that fear loses its grip, while attempts to cloud their judgement or sway their will are met with remarkable resistance. Although those who seek refuge after succumbing to such effects may still recover, the greatest protection is reserved for those who remain within your light from the beginning.

As your mastery grows, your companions begin to place complete trust in your presence, knowing that while your aura surrounds them, neither fear nor deception can easily break their resolve.

### Effects

- Spend **35 MP** to activate **Aura of Courage**.
- Create a **10 metre radius Aura** centred on yourself for **5 Rounds**.
- The aura moves with you.
- Allies already within the aura gain **+4 to Saving Throws against the Fear and Charm conditions**.
- If an ally is targeted by a Fear or Charm effect while already inside the aura, the **+4 bonus** is applied to their Saving Throw.
- An ally that enters the aura while suffering the **Fear** or **Charm** condition may immediately attempt **one new Saving Throw** to end one of those effects.
- This Saving Throw gains **+2** *(half the aura's normal bonus, rounded down)*.
- This reroll may only be attempted **once per aura activation** for each creature.
- Multiple **Aura of Courage** effects do not stack. If affected by more than one, only the strongest version applies.

### Lore

To witness a veteran Paladin standing firm amid impossible odds is to understand why courage is considered contagious. Their presence inspires more than confidence—it reminds those around them who they are, what they fight for, and why no force should be allowed to bend their will.

Many scholars believe this is the stage at which a Paladin's faith begins to resonate with the souls of those nearby. Whether divine miracle or simple inspiration, those who stand within the aura often recall hearing the Paladin's voice clearly above the chaos of battle, guiding them back to themselves when fear and enchantment sought to steal their resolve.

> *"A frightened heart may stumble. A faithful heart always finds its way home."*  
> **— High Justicar Alaric, Keeper of the Sacred Bastion**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your courage has become an unwavering bastion of the mind. Those who stand beside you find their thoughts steadied, their resolve strengthened, and their spirits shielded from forces that seek to overwhelm, deceive, or corrupt them. Fear no longer stands alone as your enemy—any assault upon the will itself struggles against the divine conviction you project.

The aura surrounding you radiates calm amidst chaos. Companions fighting beneath your protection discover that even the darkest horrors and most insidious enchantments lose much of their power. While those who seek refuge after succumbing to such effects may still recover, those who remain steadfast within your presence receive the greatest blessing of your unwavering faith.

The strongest Paladins understand that courage is not merely the absence of fear. It is the strength to remain true to yourself when every force in the world attempts to make you someone else.

### Effects

- Spend **40 MP** to activate **Aura of Courage**.
- Create a **12 metre radius Aura** centred on yourself for **6 Rounds**.
- The aura moves with you.
- Allies already within the aura gain **+5 to Saving Throws** against the **Fear**, **Charm**, and **Mental** conditions or effects.
- If an ally is targeted by a Fear, Charm, or Mental effect while already inside the aura, the **+5 bonus** is applied to their Saving Throw.
- An ally that enters the aura while suffering from one of these effects may immediately attempt **one new Saving Throw** to end a single qualifying effect.
- This Saving Throw gains **+2** *(half the aura's normal bonus, rounded down)*.
- This reroll may only be attempted **once per aura activation** for each creature.
- Multiple **Aura of Courage** effects do not stack. If affected by more than one, only the strongest version applies.

### Lore

By the time a Paladin reaches this level of mastery, their presence has become a sanctuary for the minds and hearts of those around them. Countless tales tell of warriors standing firm against eldritch horrors, ancient dragons, and master enchanters simply because they refused to leave the reassuring light of a Paladin's aura.

Many theologians believe this is where divine courage transcends emotion and becomes something greater—a sacred certainty that cannot easily be shaken. Those who have fought beside such champions often recall feeling as though no darkness, however terrible, could truly reach them while they remained within the Paladin's light.

> *"Darkness first seeks to conquer the mind. Stand within the light, and let your resolve answer instead."*  
> **— Saint Aurelia, Keeper of the Eternal Flame**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your courage has become a divine sanctuary upon the battlefield. Those who fight beside you stand beneath the protection of an unwavering spirit, their resolve fortified by the sacred conviction that radiates from your very soul. Terror, manipulation and despair struggle to take hold against those sheltered within your presence.

Your aura is no longer simply a source of inspiration—it is a bastion against the forces that seek to break the will. Allies who remain within your light find themselves standing firm against horrors that would send entire armies fleeing, while those who return to your protection after succumbing to darkness are given one final opportunity to reclaim themselves.

Among the greatest Paladins, Aura of Courage is remembered as the defining symbol of their leadership. It is said that when such champions stand their ground, hope itself refuses to retreat.

### Effects

- Spend **455 MP** to activate **Aura of Courage**.
- Create a **15 metre radius Aura** centred on yourself for **8 Rounds**.
- The aura moves with you.
- Allies already within the aura have **Advantage on Saving Throws** against the **Fear**, **Charm**, and **Mental** conditions or effects.
- If an ally is targeted by a qualifying effect while already inside the aura, they make the Saving Throw with **Advantage**.
- An ally that enters the aura while already suffering one of these effects may immediately attempt **one new Saving Throw** to end a single qualifying effect.
- This Saving Throw gains **+4**.
- This reroll may only be attempted **once per aura activation** for each creature.
- Multiple **Aura of Courage** effects do not stack. If affected by more than one, only the strongest version applies.

### Lore

The oldest legends speak of Paladins whose courage burned so brightly that despair itself could not enter their presence. Their companions marched into impossible battles without hesitation, not because they believed victory was certain, but because they knew they would never face the darkness alone.

To stand within the Aura of Courage is to be reminded of every oath sworn, every sacrifice made, and every reason worth fighting for. In those moments, fear becomes merely another obstacle to overcome, and hope becomes as tangible as the shield held before you.

> *"Hope is not a feeling. It is the courage to stand when every voice tells you to flee."*  
> **— Saint Aurelian, First Warden of the Radiant Host**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Divine Sense
entries.body:
# Divine Sense

## Overview
Through unwavering devotion, a Paladin learns to quiet the distractions of the physical world and listen instead to the whispers of the divine. By opening their soul to their patron, they briefly perceive the unseen spiritual currents that flow through the world, revealing sacred presences and forces that stand in direct opposition to their deity's will.

Divine Sense is not ordinary sight, nor does it reveal every hidden creature or secret. Instead, it awakens a deeper awareness that allows a Paladin to recognise the subtle resonance of divine power. Holy places, relics, miracles and supernatural beings leave impressions upon the world that only those blessed by a patron can perceive.

As your connection to your patron deepens, so too will your understanding of these spiritual echoes. What begins as a faint awareness will eventually become the ability to discern the true nature of divine and opposing forces that shape the world around you.

## Rank 1
### Description

Through unwavering devotion, a Paladin learns to quiet the distractions of the physical world and listen instead to the whispers of the divine. By opening their soul to their patron, they briefly perceive the unseen spiritual currents that flow through the world, revealing sacred presences and forces that stand in direct opposition to their deity's will.

Divine Sense is not ordinary sight, nor does it reveal every hidden creature or secret. Instead, it awakens a deeper awareness that allows a Paladin to recognise the subtle resonance of divine power. Holy places, relics, miracles and supernatural beings leave impressions upon the world that only those blessed by a patron can perceive.

As your connection to your patron deepens, so too will your understanding of these spiritual echoes. What begins as a faint awareness will eventually become the ability to discern the true nature of divine and opposing forces that shape the world around you.

### Effects

- Spend **25 MP** to activate **Divine Sense**.
- Divine Sense remains active for **1 Minute (10 Rounds)**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Resonance** associated with your patron deity within **10 metres**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Opposition** associated with your patron deity within **10 metres**.
- Divine Sense reveals only the **presence** of these forces and does not reveal their exact location, identity, strength, or source.
- While Divine Sense is active, gain **+2 to Perception Checks** made to investigate or locate sensed divine presences.
- Powerful magical barriers, divine wards, or abilities specifically designed to conceal spiritual signatures may prevent Divine Sense from detecting a target at the GM's discretion.
- The creatures, magic, relics, locations, and phenomena detected by **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your chosen patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

Every deity leaves a unique imprint upon creation. Those who devote themselves to a patron gradually learn to recognise that sacred resonance, just as they instinctively perceive the opposing forces that seek to challenge or corrupt it. To a trained Paladin, these spiritual echoes are as unmistakable as a familiar voice carried upon the wind.

The oldest holy orders teach that Divine Sense is the first true step toward becoming a champion of one's faith. Before a Paladin can confront the enemies of their patron, they must first learn to recognise the subtle signs of divine influence that surround them, whether they come from friend or foe.

> *"The divine speaks long before steel is drawn. Those who learn to listen will never truly walk blind."*  
> **— High Oracle Seraphis, Keeper of the Sacred Vigil**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your connection to your patron grows stronger, allowing you to perceive more than a simple spiritual presence. As your awareness deepens, the countless echoes of divine energy begin to separate into distinct signatures, enabling you to recognise when multiple sources are nearby instead of sensing only that something exists.

The world becomes layered with unseen currents of divine influence. While ordinary people pass through sacred and opposing powers unaware, your patron grants you the insight to distinguish individual spiritual presences hidden beneath the surface of reality. Though the details remain beyond your understanding, you can begin to judge the scale of what surrounds you.

Veteran Paladins describe this stage as learning to hear individual voices within a crowded room. The divine still speaks in whispers, but those whispers are no longer impossible to separate.

### Effects

- Spend **30 MP** to activate **Divine Sense**.
- Divine Sense remains active for **2 Minutes (20 Rounds)**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Resonance** associated with your patron deity within **15 metres**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Opposition** associated with your patron deity within **15 metres**.
- Determine the **number of distinct divine presences** detected within range.
- Divine Sense does not reveal the exact location, identity, strength, or source of detected presences.
- Gain **+4 to Perception Checks** made to investigate or locate sensed divine presences while Divine Sense is active.
- Powerful magical barriers, divine wards, or abilities specifically designed to conceal spiritual signatures may prevent Divine Sense from detecting a target at the GM's discretion.
- The creatures, relics, magic, locations, and phenomena detected through **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your chosen patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

As devotion matures into unwavering faith, a Paladin begins to perceive the harmony and discord that exist between divine powers. No longer overwhelmed by the countless echoes surrounding them, they learn to distinguish one sacred presence from another, revealing a richer understanding of the unseen world.

Within the great religious orders, this level of mastery marks the point at which initiates are trusted to investigate sacred sites and spiritual disturbances without constant guidance. Their patron's voice has become clearer, allowing them to recognise not merely that something is present, but that many unseen forces may be moving together beneath the veil.

> *"The divine rarely speaks alone. Learn to count the voices before you choose which one to follow."*  
> **— High Oracle Seraphis, Keeper of the Sacred Vigil**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your soul has become finely attuned to your patron's divine influence, allowing you to perceive not only the existence of sacred and opposing spiritual forces, but also the direction from which they emanate. What once felt like distant whispers now forms a clearer path for your spirit to follow.

As your awareness deepens, the divine currents surrounding the world become easier to navigate. You can distinguish whether a presence lies ahead, behind, above, or below, allowing you to pursue hidden relics, uncover concealed sanctuaries, or prepare for encounters with opposing divine forces before they reveal themselves.

Although the finer details remain hidden, your patron's guidance grows stronger with every step. Divine Sense begins to transform from a simple warning into a trusted companion, leading faithful champions toward both sacred discoveries and dangerous confrontations.

### Effects

- Spend **35 MP** to activate **Divine Sense**.
- Divine Sense remains active for **3 Minutes (30 Rounds)**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Resonance** associated with your patron deity within **20 metres**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Opposition** associated with your patron deity within **20 metres**.
- Determine the **number of distinct divine presences** detected within range.
- Determine the **general direction** of each detected presence.
- Discern whether each presence is **Near**, **Moderate**, or **Distant** relative to your current position.
- Divine Sense still does not reveal the identity, exact location, or strength of detected presences.
- Gain **+6 to Perception Checks** made to investigate or locate sensed divine presences while Divine Sense is active.
- Powerful magical barriers, divine wards, or abilities specifically designed to conceal spiritual signatures may prevent Divine Sense from detecting a target at the GM's discretion.
- The creatures, relics, magic, locations, and phenomena detected through **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your chosen patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

The greatest Paladins often describe the world as a tapestry woven from countless unseen threads of divine influence. With experience, those threads become easier to follow, guiding faithful champions toward forgotten temples, hidden relics, and the growing presence of forces that oppose their patron's divine purpose.

Religious scholars believe this marks the moment a Paladin ceases to simply perceive the divine and instead begins to navigate by it. Many legendary journeys have begun with nothing more than a quiet whisper carried upon the soul, faithfully followed until destiny revealed itself.

> *"The divine does not point with a finger. It whispers, and the faithful learn which way to walk."*  
> **— High Oracle Seraphis, Keeper of the Sacred Vigil**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your bond with your patron has matured into a profound spiritual awareness. The divine echoes surrounding the world no longer appear as indistinct whispers but as recognisable signatures, each carrying its own strength and purpose. Your soul instinctively interprets these impressions, allowing you to better understand the unseen forces shaping the world around you.

Where younger Paladins merely sense that something sacred or opposing is nearby, you begin to distinguish the nature of each presence. Ancient relics resonate differently from living champions, while consecrated temples and corrupted ground each leave their own unmistakable imprint upon the divine tapestry.

Although many mysteries still remain hidden, your patron grants you enough insight to judge which discoveries deserve caution, reverence, or immediate action.

### Effects

- Spend **40 MP** to activate **Divine Sense**.
- Divine Sense remains active for **5 Minutes (50 Rounds)**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Resonance** associated with your patron deity within **25 metres**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Opposition** associated with your patron deity within **25 metres**.
- Determine the **number**, **general direction**, and **relative proximity** of each detected presence.
- Discern the **relative strength** of each presence as **Faint**, **Moderate**, **Powerful**, or **Overwhelming**.
- Determine whether each detected presence originates from a **creature**, **relic**, **location**, **divine phenomenon**, or **active magical effect**, though its exact identity remains unknown.
- Gain **+8 to Perception Checks** made to investigate or locate sensed divine presences while Divine Sense is active.
- Powerful magical barriers, divine wards, or abilities specifically designed to conceal spiritual signatures may prevent Divine Sense from detecting a target at the GM's discretion.
- The creatures, relics, magic, locations, and phenomena detected through **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your chosen patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

Only the most devoted champions reach the point where divine echoes become distinct voices. Experienced Paladins learn that every sacred relic, every consecrated sanctuary, and every being touched by divine power leaves behind a unique resonance upon the world. To the faithful, these impressions are as recognisable as a familiar face.

Masters of Divine Sense are often entrusted with recovering lost relics, investigating miraculous events, and uncovering hidden threats that would escape even the keenest mortal senses. Their patron's guidance has become more than intuition—it has become a trusted companion upon every journey.

> *"The divine leaves its mark upon everything it touches. Wisdom lies in learning how to read those marks."*  
> **— High Oracle Seraphis, Keeper of the Sacred Vigil**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your soul has become completely attuned to the divine will of your patron. No longer limited to sensing faint echoes, you briefly perceive the spiritual tapestry that binds the world together, allowing you to witness the true resonance and opposition surrounding you.

Sacred places blaze like stars within your awareness, while opposing divine forces stand out as undeniable distortions against your patron's design. Even hidden relics, disguised champions, and concealed manifestations struggle to remain unseen beneath your divine gaze. Although your patron never grants perfect omniscience, few spiritual secrets can remain hidden from one who has reached this level of devotion.

Masters of Divine Sense are often called the Eyes of the Faith. They are entrusted with uncovering forgotten sanctuaries, locating divine relics, exposing corrupted holy sites, and recognising those who secretly serve powers beyond mortal understanding.

### Effects

- Spend **50 MP** to activate **Divine Sense**.
- Divine Sense remains active for **10 Minutes (100 Rounds)**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Resonance** associated with your patron deity within **30 metres**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Opposition** associated with your patron deity within **30 metres**.
- Determine the **number**, **general direction**, **relative proximity**, and **relative strength** of every detected presence.
- Determine whether each presence originates from a **creature**, **relic**, **location**, **divine phenomenon**, or **active magical effect**.
- Reveal the **approximate location** of each detected presence within your sensing range.
- Hidden, invisible, disguised, or magically concealed divine presences are revealed unless protected by an exceptionally powerful divine artifact, deity, or magical effect, at the GM's discretion.
- Gain **+10 to Perception Checks** made to investigate or locate sensed divine presences while Divine Sense is active.
- The creatures, relics, magic, locations, and phenomena detected through **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your chosen patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

Among every holy order, only a handful of Paladins ever master Divine Sense to this degree. Those who do are said to walk with one foot in the mortal realm and the other within the divine, perceiving spiritual truths hidden from all but the gods themselves.

Legends tell of champions who uncovered forgotten temples buried beneath mountains, exposed kings secretly serving rival deities, and located sacred relics thought lost for centuries. Whether these tales are fact or embellishment matters little, for every order agrees upon one truth: those who attain this gift become living instruments of their patron's will, seeing the world through eyes forever changed by divine purpose.

> *"When the veil is lifted, the world reveals what it has always been. Only the faithful possess the courage to truly see it."*  
> **— Saint Asterion, First Divine Seeker**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Lay on Hands
entries.body:
# Lay on Hands

## Overview
The divine power entrusted to a Paladin is not reserved solely for battle. Through unwavering faith and a compassionate heart, you learn to channel your patron's blessing directly through your hands, mending wounds and easing suffering with a simple touch.

When you place your hand upon another creature, divine energy flows from your soul into theirs. Flesh begins to mend, pain subsides, and the spark of life is strengthened. Though the miracle is modest at first, every act of healing reflects the sacred bond between you and your patron.

Lay on Hands is more than a healing technique—it is a symbol of a Paladin's purpose. Whether tending to a wounded ally after battle or saving a life in the heat of combat, your touch reminds those around you that hope still exists even in the darkest moments.

## Rank 1
### Description

The divine power entrusted to a Paladin is not reserved solely for battle. Through unwavering faith and a compassionate heart, you learn to channel your patron's blessing directly through your hands, mending wounds and easing suffering with a simple touch.

When you place your hand upon another creature, divine energy flows from your soul into theirs. Flesh begins to mend, pain subsides, and the spark of life is strengthened. Though the miracle is modest at first, every act of healing reflects the sacred bond between you and your patron.

Lay on Hands is more than a healing technique—it is a symbol of a Paladin's purpose. Whether tending to a wounded ally after battle or saving a life in the heat of combat, your touch reminds those around you that hope still exists even in the darkest moments.

### Effects

- Spend **25 MP** to channel divine energy through your touch.
- Target one willing creature or yourself within **Touch** range.
- Restore **2d8 + your Charisma Modifier** HP.
- Lay on Hands has no effect on creatures that cannot naturally benefit from divine healing, as determined by the GM.
- A creature may only benefit from **Lay on Hands** once per round.
- This ability does not restore lost limbs, cure permanent injuries, or remove magical conditions unless another ability specifically allows it.
- If your patron grants additional healing benefits through its Religious pages, apply those effects after the healing is resolved.

### Lore

Across every holy order, the first miracle taught to aspiring Paladins is not how to smite their enemies, but how to preserve life. Masters believe that one who cannot value the lives of others has no right to wield divine judgement.

Stories tell of weary knights walking battlefields long after the fighting had ended, offering healing to friend and stranger alike. While their names may fade with time, those they saved carried their kindness forward, proving that even the smallest act of compassion can echo through history.

> *"A sword may end a battle, but a healing hand ensures someone lives to see tomorrow."*  
> **— Saint Elyra, First Hand of Mercy**

## Rank 2
### Description

As your devotion deepens, the divine energy flowing through your hands becomes stronger and more refined. No longer limited to closing wounds, your blessing is capable of reigniting fading life, offering hope to those standing at death's door.

Veteran Paladins learn that true strength is measured not by the foes they defeat, but by the lives they preserve. In the chaos of battle, a single touch can restore an ally's resolve, allowing them to rise once more and continue fighting beside their companions.

Although your gift has grown, it remains an expression of your patron's compassion rather than limitless power. Every healing miracle is a sacred responsibility, reminding the Paladin that divine power exists to protect and preserve before it is ever used to judge.

### Effects

- Spend **35 MP** to channel divine energy through your touch.
- Target one willing creature or yourself within **Touch** range.
- Restore **4d8 + your Charisma Modifier** HP.
- If the target is **Dying**, they immediately become **Stabilised** before healing is applied.
- If the target is unconscious due to reaching **0 HP**, they regain consciousness after receiving healing.
- A creature may only benefit from **Lay on Hands** once per round.
- Lay on Hands does not restore lost limbs, cure permanent injuries, or remove conditions unless another ability specifically allows it.
- If your patron grants additional healing benefits through its Religious pages, apply those effects after the healing is resolved.

### Lore

Within every Paladin Order, this level of mastery is regarded as the first true miracle. To pull a companion back from the brink of death is considered one of the highest expressions of faith, demonstrating absolute trust between champion and patron.

Many tales recount Paladins kneeling amidst ruined battlefields, laying a single hand upon a fallen ally before watching life return where moments earlier there had been only silence. Such miracles remind both friend and foe alike that hope endures wherever divine compassion is carried.

> *"Life is the greatest gift entrusted to us. To preserve it is the first duty of every faithful hand."*  
> **— Saint Elyra, First Hand of Mercy**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your patron's blessing now flows through your hands with remarkable purity, restoring not only flesh but the vitality of the body itself. Wounds knit together with greater speed, while harmful ailments begin to fade beneath the overwhelming presence of divine power.

Seasoned Paladins understand that not every battle is won with steel alone. Venoms, diseases and lingering injuries can claim as many lives as any weapon, and so your sacred gift evolves to combat these hidden threats. A single touch can now relieve suffering that would otherwise burden an adventurer long after the battle has ended.

As your mastery grows, Lay on Hands becomes recognised as one of the greatest symbols of a Paladin's compassion. It is a miracle that preserves life, restores hope, and reminds the faithful that even in suffering, the divine has not abandoned them.

### Effects

- Spend **45 MP** to channel divine energy through your touch.
- Target one willing creature or yourself within **Touch** range.
- Restore **6d8 + your Charisma Modifier** HP.
- If the target is **Dying**, they immediately become **Stabilised** before healing is applied.
- If the target is unconscious due to reaching **0 HP**, they regain consciousness after receiving healing.
- Choose **one** of the following conditions affecting the target to immediately remove:
  - **Bleeding**
  - **Poisoned**
  - **Diseased**
- The GM may rule that particularly powerful poisons or diseases require a higher rank of **Lay on Hands** or additional treatment.
- A creature may only benefit from **Lay on Hands** once per round.
- If your patron grants additional restorative blessings through its Religious pages, apply those effects after all healing and restoration have been resolved.

### Lore

To the faithful, this level of mastery marks the moment a Paladin truly becomes a guardian of life. Their touch no longer merely closes wounds—it restores the body's natural harmony, allowing it to cast off afflictions that would cripple ordinary mortals.

Throughout Asteria, stories are told of Paladins walking plague-ridden villages, tending poisoned adventurers, and saving companions who had long since been given up for dead. Such miracles are remembered not because they display overwhelming power, but because they embody the compassion that lies at the heart of every sacred oath.

> *"Mercy is the greatest miracle. Healing is simply the form it chooses to take."*  
> **— Saint Elyra, First Hand of Mercy**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron's blessing now flows through you as a true divine miracle. Your touch no longer simply heals wounds—it restores the body to the state it was meant to be. Broken flesh mends, lingering afflictions are driven from the soul, and those suffering from grievous injuries find renewed strength through your unwavering faith.

Veteran Paladins are often sought long after battles have ended, for they possess the ability to heal suffering beyond the reach of ordinary medicine. Venoms that would claim kingdoms, illnesses that have resisted every remedy, and debilitating injuries that would end a warrior's career all yield before the divine power flowing through your hands.

To wield such a gift is considered one of the highest responsibilities bestowed upon a Paladin. Every miracle reminds the faithful that divine compassion is measured not by power alone, but by the lives restored through its grace.

### Effects

- Spend **60 MP** to channel divine energy through your touch.
- Target one willing creature or yourself within **Touch** range.
- Restore **8d8 + your Charisma Modifier** HP.
- If the target is **Dying**, they immediately become **Stabilised** before healing is applied.
- If the target is unconscious due to reaching **0 HP**, they regain consciousness after receiving healing.
- Choose up to **two** of the following conditions affecting the target to immediately remove:
  - **Bleeding**
  - **Poisoned**
  - **Diseased**
  - **Blinded**
  - **Deafened**
  - **Paralysed**
- Mend broken bones, torn muscles, and other serious physical injuries at the GM's discretion.
- Powerful magical diseases, legendary poisons, divine afflictions, and powerful curses may require **Lay on Hands — Rank V** or another specialised ability.
- A creature may only benefit from **Lay on Hands** once per round.
- If your patron grants additional restorative blessings through its Religious pages, apply those effects after all healing and restoration have been resolved.

### Lore

Among the greatest holy orders, Paladins who master this blessing become known as Living Sanctuaries. Entire villages celebrate their arrival, for their touch has ended plagues, restored broken champions, and returned hope where despair had taken root.

Though many marvel at the miracles performed by these champions, every Paladin understands that the gift is not truly their own. They are merely the hands through which their patron chooses to extend compassion into the mortal world.

> *"Power may win a battle, but mercy ensures there is still a world worth protecting when the battle is over."*  
> **— Saint Elyra, First Hand of Mercy**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your hands have become a true conduit for your patron's divine grace. Through unwavering faith and absolute devotion, you perform miracles that few mortals will ever witness. Wounds that should prove fatal are restored, devastating afflictions are washed away, and broken bodies are renewed through the overwhelming power entrusted to you.

Those who master Lay on Hands are revered across Asteria as living instruments of divine mercy. Kings seek their counsel, armies march beneath their blessing, and entire communities celebrate their arrival, knowing that hope itself walks beside them. Though your gift borders upon the miraculous, every act of healing serves as a reminder that true power exists not to conquer, but to preserve life.

Even at its pinnacle, this blessing is not limitless. Some curses, divine judgements, and god-forged afflictions lie beyond the reach of mortal champions, requiring direct divine intervention or extraordinary relics to overcome. Such mysteries remind every Paladin that they are not the source of the miracle—they are simply its faithful vessel.

### Effects

- Spend **80 MP** to channel your patron's divine power through your touch.
- Target one willing creature or yourself within **Touch** range.
- Restore **10d8 + your Charisma Modifier** HP.
- If the target is **Dying**, they immediately become **Stabilised** before healing is applied.
- If the target is unconscious due to reaching **0 HP**, they regain consciousness after receiving healing.
- Remove **all Minor and Major Physical Conditions** affecting the target.
- Remove **all Minor and Major Diseases, Poisons, and Natural Afflictions** affecting the target.
- Remove **one Lesser or Greater Curse, Divine Affliction, or Magical Ailment**, provided it does not exceed the limits determined by the GM or your patron's Religious pages.
- Restore severe physical injuries, including broken bones, damaged organs, and other debilitating wounds, at the GM's discretion.
- A creature may only benefit from **Lay on Hands** once per round.
- If your patron grants additional restorative blessings through its Religious pages, apply those effects after all healing and restoration have been resolved.

### Lore

Throughout history, only a handful of Paladins have ever reached this level of mastery. Their names are remembered not for the battles they won, but for the countless lives they preserved when all hope had been lost. Their touch became synonymous with mercy itself, a reminder that even amidst endless conflict, compassion remains the greatest expression of divine power.

Legends tell of champions who cleansed cursed kingdoms, restored heroes thought beyond saving, and stood beside the dying until the light of life returned to their eyes. Whether these tales have grown with time or remain entirely true is known only to the gods, but every holy order agrees upon one truth: to wield such a miracle is the highest honour a Paladin can receive.

> *"The greatest miracle is not that life can be restored, but that someone chose to preserve it."*  
> **— Saint Elyra, First Hand of Mercy**
